verdict.rationale: The evidence never explicitly mentions token streaming (no SSE, no `stream: true`). Support is only implied: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, plus the Anthropic Messages and Open Responses APIs, and claims existing OpenAI clients pointed at it 'keep working', which would include streaming calls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of streaming responses (SSE/stream parameter) on chat/completions endpoints, examples of consuming streamed tokens, and independent or hands-on confirmation that streaming works.
